description: This file defines the 'Article' controller class for the Opencart admin CMS module, handling CRUD operations, listing, form rendering, status toggling, and deletion of articles.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS articles in Opencart admin panel, including listing, editing, saving, enabling/disabling, and deleting articles.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the article list page with filters, breadcrumbs, and related data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to render the list of articles.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying a list of articles with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the article creation/edit form with pre-filled data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated article data, including validation and SEO URL checks.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Schedules a task to recalculate or update article ratings.
